The cup's session leads the Pulse while it runs; a Finals card never shares a widget with the cup (L3, M12).
With no session live, a mini tournament's bracket takes the hero, in the platform's look (M11).
Finals cards keep the app's own graphics and theming; drawn here only as a placeholder (0030 point 1).
One Play list: the cup, the open mini tournaments, and a Finals tile that opens the app signed in (M12).
No Finals result adds cup points; each has its own champions; no data is synced (0030 point 6, M10).
Moments: the cup's Champion is Tournament's; a Finals champion comes through the app's connection (M12).
